description: Celebration & interaction juice: pooled sparkle bursts at the goal cup on every collect, confetti + enriched solved overlay with instant replay of the same solved track, and tactile interaction feedback — reject wiggle, valid-drop snap-bounce, palette pickup, rotate tap animation. Reduced-motion fallbacks, existing CC0 samples only, no new dependencies; verified by unit tests, extended e2e hooks, and the existing 4-viewport matrix + reliability gate.
